name: TIR-Bench
description: TIR-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate agentic thinking-with-images reasoning capabilities in multimodal large language models. It covers 13 diverse tasks requiring novel tool use for image processing and manipulation in chain-of-thought reasoning, addressing limitations of existing benchmarks that focus on basic visual operations.
reputation: A very recent arXiv benchmark that is gaining attention in multimodal reasoning research, but it is not yet widely established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on advanced agentic tool use for image reasoning beyond basic visual search tasks.
